keyword: how much to spend on an engagement ring

ai_overview.markdown:
You should spend an amount on an [engagement ring](https://www.estatediamondjewelry.com/engagement-ring-calculator/) that fits comfortably within your personal finances without creating debt.[[1]](https://www.reddit.com/r/engaged/comments/1h2cgit/how_much_is_appropriate_or_the_average_to_spend/)[[2]](https://www.doamore.com/how-much-spend-engagement-ring/)

### Average Costs

- The average cost of an engagement ring in the U.S. ranges from **$5,200 to $6,500**.
- Natural diamond rings average around **$10,700** , while lab-grown diamond rings average about **$5,100**.
- Many buyers spend anywhere from **$1,000 to $3,000** , while others spend much more depending on their budget.[[1]](https://www.vogue.com/article/how-much-should-i-spend-on-an-engagement-ring)[[2]](https://www.gabrielny.com/blog/how-much-should-you-spend-on-an-engagement-ring/)[[3]](https://www.americanexpress.com/en-us/credit-cards/credit-intel/engagement-ring-cost/)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/ZzKfuxhvdQg)

### Old Rules vs. Modern Advice

- **The salary rule:** Older marketing traditions suggest spending one to three months' worth of salary. Financial experts and jewelers now view this rule as outdated.
- **The realistic approach:** Prioritize your savings, monthly expenses, and shared future goals over any rigid formula.[[1]](https://www.facebook.com/rachelramseycruze/posts/how-much-to-spend-on-an-engagement-ring-/1542440653901571/)[[2]](https://www.vogue.com/article/how-much-should-i-spend-on-an-engagement-ring)[[3]](https://www.estatediamondjewelry.com/engagement-ring-calculator/)

If you'd like, let me know your **approximate budget** or whether you are looking at **natural versus lab-grown stones** , and I can help you figure out what options and styles fit that range.
